title: The offset wheel on a geared carrier
intent: From the fixed front view, determine how wheel P changes its own orientation and how its bearing on H travels around the common fixed center of S and H at the shown instant.

choices.reason: The outer A-B mesh drives H counterclockwise through B. Seen from H, S turns clockwise. P follows S through two outer meshes at 24/36 of its relative speed. Adding H's larger counterclockwise speed gives P a counterclockwise frame spin.
This reports P's clockwise spin as seen by a rider on H. The frame observer must also include H's counterclockwise angular velocity.
Giving B the same sense as A carries a clockwise error into H and P. The labeled A-B contact is an external mesh and reverses the drive.
Perfect cancellation would hold with equal end wheels. The 36-tooth P gains only two thirds of the clockwise relative speed of the 24-tooth S, leaving a counterclockwise frame spin.
